audience: schedulers who plan jobs, bookings and shifts for people, rooms and vehicles in Schedule it

useCases.title: See what is on the schedule and who it is assigned to
useCases.text: The AI lists events in a date range, with title, dates, notes and the linked resources, and the names of those resources.

useCases.title: Find events that changed since a given time
useCases.text: The AI fetches only the events modified after a time you name, so you see what was added or changed since yesterday.

useCases.title: List the resources of a group with their details
useCases.text: The AI lists resource groups, such as Staff, Rooms or Vehicles, and the resources in them with fields like name and email.

useCases.title: Create an event for a resource
useCases.text: The AI creates an event (booking, shift, job or task) with title and dates, linked to one or more resources. Everyone with access to the schedule can see it.

useCases.title: Change or delete an event
useCases.text: The AI changes the title, dates, notes or linked resources of an event, or deletes an event for good when you ask for it.

useCases.title: Add or change a resource or a resource group
useCases.text: The AI adds a person, room or piece of equipment, changes a resource's details and groups, or adds and renames a resource group.
